text: Food science is an interdisciplinary field that integrates biology, chemistry, engineering, and nutrition. Its core lies in studying the scientific principles and technical applications of the entire food chain from "raw materials to the table", including the composition characteristics, processing techniques, quality safety, nutritional health, and storage preservation of food. It not only focuses on "how to make food tastier and safer", but also explores "how to improve health and solve food problems through food", and is a key discipline that connects agricultural production and human health.
